message_content: Juanzi, I've picked up Hanhan. I'm heading back to get you now. Get ready to come downstairs.
Brother Jianguo, during the safety class at noon, I still have some questions about the residual current protective device. I'll ask you when we meet at the construction site in the afternoon.
[China Telecom] Dear customer, you have successfully completed the broadband renewal and gigabit upgrade service. The new router will be delivered tomorrow. For details, call 10000.
Mom, good morning! The weather is nice today. Remember to put on extra clothes. I feel great after my morning exercise.
Me: Jianguo, leaving now, see you at Times Square.
Kids, the kindergarten has informed us that our family has been named Reading Star! The digital certificate has the names of all four of us!
Me: Mom, we'll be there around ten o'clock. The kids brought Ludo and some drawings.
Juanzi, let me help you peel the potatoes.
Mr. Liu, the emergency repair at Binhai Mingzhu is complete. Power has been restored, and the fault has been eliminated.
Jianguo, I'm leaving early. From now on, I won't join the card games. It's better for us to have tea and go running.
Juanzi, I've already dropped Xuanxuan and Hanhan off at school. Don't worry.
Me: Mr. Liu, all the old lines on Yanzao Road have been removed this afternoon, and the new lines can be laid tomorrow.
Honey, I bought Hainan noodles and seaweed rolls. I'll be home soon. You can get the bowls and chopsticks ready.
Me: Zhao Qiang, remember to bring insulating gloves and test for electricity first when you arrive on site.
The training is over and I feel good. Is breakfast ready?
Juanzi, I have to share experience at the evening meeting, so I may get home a little later. You all go ahead and have dinner first, no need to wait for me.
Just finished a run and a chat with Juanzi, and I feel much more at ease.
Zhao Qiang, at the morning meeting I received a fault report on the distribution cabinet at Xiuying Port. Bring the usual tools, and we'll set off together after the meeting.
Honey, the car insurance has been renewed. Compulsory traffic insurance plus vehicle and vessel tax comes to 950 yuan. I've sent a screenshot to your phone.
[China Mobile] You have successfully upgraded to the 30GB data plan, effective next month.
Brother Jianguo, the Industrial Memory you recommended is fantastic! Just finished the first episode. Thanks for the recommendation!
Juanzi, there will be thundershowers in the afternoon. Remember to bring an umbrella when you go to the hospital to get medicine.
Boss, please save a qingbuliang for me; I'll come to pick it up in a little while.

message_content: Juanzi: How is Xuanxuan's review going? Do you need help?
I bought tilapia and water spinach. Tonight I'll make steamed fish and garlic water spinach.
Me: Xiao Zhao, the team morning meeting is at 8, remember to bring the warehouse inventory sheet.
Coach Lin, tonight's backhand special training was great, thank you for your patient guidance!
Insulation resistance readings are up to standard, tools have been counted and put back in place, and the wrap-up is complete.
Afeng, today's backhand special training was so satisfying, thanks for feeding me the ball! Let's do it again next time.
Dad, I went to my son's school today for the parent-child reading event. He went up on stage to demonstrate a circuit and did great!
Mom: Good morning, remember to eat breakfast today, don't go to work on an empty stomach.
Master Li, my review is going smoothly, and I have fully mastered those difficult points. Thank you for your tips and guidance!
Team leader Zhang, the oxidation of the C-phase terminal of the A1 distribution box has been treated. After sanding and cleaning, the contact resistance is normal. Photos have been taken.
Jianguo, we'll set off at 8:30 to inspect Xinghai Road. Bring all the tools and record books, and remember to wear your safety helmet.
Mom, I just took a shower. Xiaojuan helped me put on a medicated patch, and my back feels much better. In the afternoon I helped Xuanxuan with math, and he improved a lot.
Lao Chen, I've looked at a few running shoes and sent you the links. Take a look when you have time?
Juanzi, the car is checked. Come downstairs and let's go.
Zhao Qiang, I've sorted out the morning inspection plan. We depart at 8:30, so get your tools ready.
Abin, I've planned interval runs for July: once a week, 8 sets of 400 meters. Want to run together on the weekend?
Mom, my weight is back to 71.8 kg, and my back feels much better. Please take care of yourself.
Team Leader Zhang, we have arrived at Haidao Sunshine Apartment and started checking the electrical circuits. Everything is going well.
Juanzi, I bought mangosteen and mangoes, as well as some for Mom and Dad. Do we need anything else?
Juanzi, about the summer interest classes, what do you think of signing Xuanxuan up for swimming and calligraphy classes?
Old Chen, today's table tennis was really enjoyable. Let's play again next time!
Mom: Zhenguo, are you up? The weather is nice today. Remember to eat breakfast.
Dad, today I made blanched shrimp and tomato scrambled eggs, and the kids were so happy eating them.
Dear, I have good news—I've been selected as a candidate for the advanced employee award today! By the way, can you help me find the work clothes I need to wear tomorrow?
Mom, we've finished breakfast, don't worry.
The old phone can't install the Smart Campus app. Why don't you try it on your phone?
Brother Feng, let's play at 7:30 tonight, see you at the usual place!
Jianguo, I've prepared a gift for tonight's KTV session. See you later!
Have you finished the practice questions?
Jianguo, the Sunday exchange meeting is at 2 PM at the Jinmao Community Activity Center. Remember to come.
Uncle Wang, thank you for your encouragement. I will do my best!
Haizi, Happy National Day! I'm hosting relatives at home today. Let's get together another day.
Zhao Qiang, today I took my son to see a generator and taught him the stator and rotor. The little guy was quite interested.
Mom, today is Juan's birthday. We'll come over to see you and Dad tomorrow.
Tonight I played the lantern projection game with Xuanxuan and Hanhan on the balcony; they were so happy. Happy Mid-Autumn Festival!
Hai Zi, today I took the two boys to plant cherry tomatoes on the balcony. They were so happy!
Me: Breakfast is ready. Hainan rice noodles with dried beef, come back and eat.
Me: Haizi, I'm playing water guns with the two boys at the hotel pool, it's so much fun!

Hello, Manager of Juxian Tower. A private room, Hongyun Pavilion, has been reserved for November 15. The dishes include Wenchang chicken, braised grouper, etc. The budget is 1,500 yuan. Please confirm.
A Jie, I made a vegetarian clay pot dish for dinner tonight. Next time bring the whole family over to try it.
Mom, it's colder today, remember to wear more clothes.
Me: Juanzi, breakfast was really good. I'll buy Xuanxuan electronic building blocks this evening, so don't wait for me for dinner.
Team Leader Zhang, the morning inspection is complete. The exhaust fan fault at the Yongwan Road switching station has been recorded; I suggest arranging a repair.
Juanzi, let's discuss Zixuan's education savings in the living room at 8 tonight. Remember to find the household registration booklet and ID card.
Just got home. Tonight's gathering was really fun. Thanks to Lao Wu for organizing! Next time, shall we take the kids to Xiuying Cultural and Creative Park?
Juanzi, I bought broccoli, corn, and prawns. I’m making a healthy meal tonight. Do we need anything else?
Juanzi, it's raining hard today. Be careful when you take the kids to and from school. I'll come back as soon as I finish the emergency repair here.
Dad, this morning my wife cooked rice noodle soup, and the kids were so happy eating it.
Mr. Liu, I'm in charge of the electric shock first aid demonstration at the 3 p.m. meeting. The PPT and mannequin are ready, so please rest assured.
Me: Juanzi, I'll send Xuanxuan to school, and you make sure Hanhan eats breakfast.
Team Leader Zhang, I've prepared the case compilation materials. The meeting starts at 8:30, right?
Me: Afeng, I'm almost there, see you at the parking lot
Brother Qiang, I brought some cured meat at lunch. Last time you said you wanted to try it. Also, is your back feeling better? Remember, the warm water I poured for you can help you relax.
Mingqiang, don't try to tough it out if you've strained your back. Tighten the tool belt around it to secure it, and use that as a temporary fix.

Mingqiang, the question bank has been copied to your USB drive and placed on the study desk. Remember to read at least two chapters a week; only persistence will let you pass the senior technician exam.
Master, did we bring the new 100A air switch? I just remembered there are still a few old ones in the warehouse.
Hello, Mr. Lu. I'm Xiao Liu, a China Unicom sales representative. Mr. Chen Jianguo recommended that you get broadband. May I contact you at your convenience to introduce the plans in detail?
Mingqiang, I heard you strained your back moving a distribution box? Feeling any better now? Remember to rub on some safflower oil and massage it, don't tough it out.
Same old place at noon? Zhao Qiang said today’s lecture was very clear.
Brother Lu, my mother's surgery went well. Thank you for lending me the 10,000 yuan. I'll repay it as soon as possible.

Today I went to my father-in-law's house to pay New Year's greetings, and we talked about taking the senior technician exam. I suddenly remembered the wine bottle story you mentioned last time. I think we can add metaphors of time brewing and the spirit of craftsmanship to make the story richer.
Don't forget to bring the tools for this afternoon's contactor maintenance.
Summarize today's work thoroughly, especially how you nearly started working without testing for voltage—how dangerous. You must keep the procedure firmly in mind.
Pre-shift meeting: Lu Ming and Chen Jianguo, one team, inspect the switching station in Xiuying District. Pay attention to safety.
Honey, look at the expression on Hanhan's face watching the lion dance — she simply can't take her eyes off it. I'm dying laughing!

Just a note: on October 15, during the competition, the judge used a multimeter to test me. I chose to check the contactor coil, and the multimeter showed an open circuit — sure enough, there was a loose connection. I also tested the alarm linkage, and it didn't trigger. In the end, it turned out the reset button was loose. The judge didn't notice anything unusual, but I need to remember to retighten it.

The examiner at workstation 7 looked at the forward-reverse motor circuit I had wired and finally said, "OK, no problem." I remember using a multimeter to test the continuity of the main circuit and control circuit. The result was that the forward rotation air switch was normal, and the reverse inverter was also fine.
Team Leader Zhang, Mingqiang's back pain flared up this morning and he can't get out of bed. He needs to take the morning off. Please approve it.
Got it, let him rest well.

[Haier After-Sales] Dear user Lu Mingqiang, the warranty for your home air conditioner filter has expired. Please contact after-sales service promptly for replacement to avoid affecting use. Contact phone: 400-699-9999.

Xiao Lu, you did an excellent job on today's acceptance check. The distribution box was neatly arranged, the labels were clearly pasted, and handing over half a day early brought honor to our department. Keep it up!
The electronic greeting card Xuanxuan made with coding is fantastic; I put on my reading glasses and looked at it for a long time!
Harvested results, everyone take a look
Lecturer Li’s lecture today on the new Work Safety Law was very thorough; I took a lot of notes.
[XX Bank] Your bank card ending in 1234 was charged 1,499 yuan at 08:40. Merchant: Apple Authorized Reseller.
When the eldest is a little older, let’s really make a trip to Wenchang to watch a rocket launch. It’s more impressive than an exhibition.
Nice going, bro!
Wang Hai: Liked your Moments post.
Hanhan was clapping the whole time—the kite flew really high!
Our big eagle kite is flying the highest, and all the kids are cheering!
Zhang Tou, the main switch trip fault in the south zone of Zhongjiao Longqi Yayuan has been handled. The leakage protector was replaced, and it is now normal.
Freshly harvested lettuce, fresh and delicious! Sharing three photos for everyone to see.
The corner of the living room is wiped clean, and the floor mat can be laid out now.
Wife, today's parent-child activity ended. The homeroom teacher, Teacher Li, specifically praised our son, saying that his concentration in class has improved quite a bit recently.
I've already booked a private room at the Wenchang chicken restaurant to celebrate Zixuan's birthday tonight, and I've prepared a gift as well.
Master Li gave me a handwritten notebook and said to work through it item by item.
Sis, our shuttle bus is almost at Haikou East Bus Station.
Mom, Dad was so patient helping me with my homework today! I understood it right away. He's really amazing.

[Ping An Insurance] Dear Lu Mingqiang, you have successfully renewed your compulsory traffic insurance and 500,000 yuan third-party liability insurance, with a total cost of 1,850 yuan. The electronic policy has been generated. Please log in to the app to view it. If you have any questions, please call 95511.
Warehouse manager, the safety rope buckle is worn and needs to be replaced. Please arrange it.
I'm on my e-bike downstairs. Come down.
Reminder: your high-voltage electrician certificate is about to expire. Please renew it as soon as possible.
contactName: Haikou Work Safety Qualification Examination Center

message_content: Breakfast is ready: rice porridge, fried eggs, and char siu bao. Hurry back and eat.
This morning's run felt great — 5 km at a 6:40 pace. Let's run together again next time!
Today they came over to make rice dumplings; the children had a great time learning. Tonight we can eat the egg yolk and pork rice dumplings.
Jianguo, want to go running at Wanlv Garden tomorrow morning?
Today I took Chen Jianguo and Zhao Qiang to Tianyi Building to inspect the electricity meter box. We found a loose terminal and dealt with it.
I'm here, at the window seat, waiting for you.
[Bank] Your credit card ending in 1234 was charged 400.00 yuan at 14:35 on April 11. Merchant: Decathlon Yixin Store.
Today at Stone Park I accompanied Hanhan to pick up lots of white coral stones and seashells. They were really beautiful!
Tonight is the family reunion dinner; I'm coming right away.
Honey, remember to buy three heavy-duty storage bins, coconut coir bricks, scallion, lettuce, and chili seeds, plus a smart timer.
Just now I held Zihan and looked at the PLC wiring diagram; he nodded as if he half understood. So cute.
I made a point of bringing an extra white-cut chicken leg.
Today I took Xuanxuan to fly a kite. He did amazingly—the kite flew so high!
Dear, I've bought rice rolls and soy milk and I'm heading home. Let's have breakfast together.

Lijuan, the education savings account has been opened. I deposited 500 yuan in cash, and 200 yuan will be transferred automatically every month. In ten years, it will be used for Xuanxuan's college education.
Master Lu, maintenance on the infrared thermometer is done, and the record card is filled out.
OK, file it away.
The plan has been reviewed. Come pick it up.
Today I urgently took Mom to Longkun Community Health Service Center. The doctor said it was rheumatic cold-induced joint pain and prescribed medicated patches and diclofenac sodium.

Master Lu, I have completed the resignation procedures and officially said goodbye. Thank you for your care over the years. I will always keep your teachings in mind. Wishing you good health and smooth work! Zhao Qiang.
The kite flew so high today, Xuanxuan was absolutely delighted!
The practical assessment on November 15 is to design and install a motor forward-reverse rotation circuit with PLC control and troubleshoot faults. Please prepare in advance.

Mingming, I've sent you the link. This is the latest question bank for the advanced electrician exam. Focus on the fault analysis and practical operation questions. Practice and discuss more with Jianguo.
Just got the score slip and confirmed I passed! [Image]
Honey, at noon I chatted with a few electricians in the cafeteria and heard about a new cable technique. It was quite inspiring.
Dad, I've brought the USB drive and the notebook. I'm now taking the electric bike to Datie Laoba Tea Shop, and I'll be there in about 15 minutes.
I'm going to play ball. I won't be back for dinner tonight. There are dishes in the fridge.

[Zhong'ao Swimming and Fitness Center] Mr. Lu Mingqiang, your father-and-sons parent-child swimming class (July 26-August 26, every Saturday 10:00-11:30) has been successfully enrolled! Swimming gear (goggles, swim caps, kickboards) has been purchased; please pick it up at the front desk with this text message. Contact Coach Li for details.
I saw it, really happy! Bring me along next time.
You paid 99 yuan to the PLC course platform at 13:50 on December 14 to purchase the 'PLC Automation Control Fundamentals' course.
I saw the video. The kids really had a great time!
From today on, dinner will be steamed or boiled, pork liver and spinach twice a week, and less alcohol. Tomorrow I'll go to the community hospital for diet advice.
Confirm that we'll go to Wenchang next month on the weekend to visit the old distillery; the exact date will be decided later.
Dad, the east window has been fixed, the latch has been reinforced, and the yard has been swept clean.
At the vegetable market, bought dwarf 'Red Jade' cherry tomato seeds and bone meal base fertilizer, then went to the general store and bought three terracotta flowerpots, spending 70 yuan.
Mingqiang, don't forget to bring a shovel and a bucket for tomorrow's tree planting.
[Image] Just got my Red Cross First Aid certificate. If anyone needs help in the future, don't hesitate to ask me!
Lao Chen, the Phase B joint of the old branch box on Gangdong Street had a temperature 15 degrees too high. I cut power, tightened and cleaned it, and it is back to normal.
Showered and ready for breakfast.
The main line at Lao Li Electrical Appliance Repair Shop is burned out. Come quickly, I'll wait for you on Haifu Road.

[China Unicom] Dear Mr. Lu Mingqiang, you have successfully subscribed to the 599 yuan/year 300M converged broadband package including IPTV. Installation will be done at your home tomorrow between 9 and 11 a.m. The order has been generated. The installer will contact you in advance, please keep your phone reachable.
At 09:15 you spent 18.00 yuan at the mackerel stall in Wenhua Market for one special-priced mackerel.
Wang Hao, see you at 7 p.m. on Thursday (July 31) at the community activity room. Let's get familiar with the ball movement first.

Dear Mr. Lu Mingqiang, you have successfully subscribed to China Unicom's 300M broadband integrated package (599 yuan/year, including IPTV). The installation engineer will come to your home between 9-11 AM on January 7, 2025. Please keep your phone reachable. If you have any questions, please call 10010. [China Unicom]
Ping An Insurance: You successfully paid the premium of 1,280 yuan for the family comprehensive accident insurance at 08:21 on December 12, and the policy has taken effect.
I bought loofah, eggs, and scallions for only 6 yuan. Tonight I'll show off my cooking.

Dear Mr. Lu Mingqiang, your vehicle has completed the engine oil and oil filter change at Ming'an Auto Repair Center. The inspection found uneven wear on the front tires. It is recommended that you have a four-wheel alignment done next week. The tire pressure has been adjusted. If you have any questions, please call 0898-68512345.
Remember to buy loofah and eggs after work; tonight we're making stir-fried loofah with eggs.
I brought the transformer protection notes. After lunch, I'll go to the parking lot and review them for a bit.
Okay, I'll eat faster?
No, you go ahead and eat first.
I checked around—the air conditioner, refrigerator, and water heater are all normal, and the current is fine. I didn't find anything wrong. I'll take another look tomorrow.
Ingredients are ready: boiled chicken breast, water spinach, and shrimp. Come by this evening to discuss the adjustment plan.
Thanks for bringing the two bottles! I will get my father's commemorative wine bottle ready, and we can display them together at the November exhibition. High five on that!
Tonight, together with Zixuan, I tested the small car we made yesterday. The wheels turned, and he was really excited.
Confirmed that the bank card is in the wallet; go buy a phone, then come back and help Zixuan make his little car.

Honey, I just went to Shichang Hardware Store on Jinmao Middle Road and bought cable ties, 502 glue, and a small hacksaw. I happened to run into our former regular customer Boss Li, who asked me to go to his shop next Tuesday to check and repair the wiring.
Zixuan adjusted the little cart's wheels, added a bit of sewing machine oil, and now they spin very smoothly.
Mom, I found an electric toothbrush and a four-wheel-drive car chassis at Mingshun Recycling Station!
I've eaten out with the kids. You can heat up the food in the fridge for yourself.
Old Lu, I just saw you running in Wanlv Park—what a coincidence!
This afternoon I ran 3 kilometers in Baishamen Park at a 7-minute pace, and it felt great.
I set off half an hour early today. Take care on the road.
Just ran into Chen Bin during interval training at Wanlv Garden, and we trained together.
After today's run, I did 15 minutes of core stretching by the river. My knees and ankles felt fine, and my endurance is much better than last month.
10 kilometers completed!
Impressive!
During the break today, I asked the teacher about the protection dead zone and the teacher explained it very clearly.
After tonight's intensive training class, on the way I'll drop by the time-honored Qingbuliang shop to pick up the two pre-ordered portions. I'll be home around ten.
Today I left work early, rode an electric bike to eat near the electric school, and prepared for the evening intensive training.
It's raining heavily outside. Don't go to class tonight—you can study another day. The roads are unsafe.
Lao Lu, shall we try that tactical combination we discussed last time next week?

It rained tonight and I didn't bring an umbrella. While taking shelter on the porch, I met Brother Li, who is studying refrigeration maintenance. We talked about cable heads and compressor faults, and I gained a lot.
The admission ticket and ID card have been put in a transparent document bag hung at the door; don't forget to take them tomorrow morning.
Just confirmed the claims process with Wu Gang; you need the invoice, diagnosis certificate, and a copy of the insurance contract.
[Company] You have received a 500 yuan electronic shopping card. It has been issued.
Lao Zhang, this morning's workout included lower back rehabilitation training, and my back feels much better.
Tomorrow morning at 8 o'clock there is a morning meeting in the office; you, Chen Jianguo, and Zhao Qiang will attend.
Mingqiang, I've packed the yiba cakes and coconut cakes in an insulated bag and put them on the shoe cabinet by the door. Don't forget to take them when you go to Master Li's house this evening.
I've just brewed some Tieguanyin tea, waiting for you to taste.
Xiaoqiang is not himself today. He keeps handing over the wrong tools. Keep an eye on him; if he can't handle it, take over.
The rain has let up a bit. Ready to head to the old office building in the west of the city.
I'll go back early tonight; I have something to talk to my son about.
Qiang, the team leader said that today the three of us are assigned as a group to go to Jinmao Building. Don't forget to bring the tools.
Master, this morning I redid the analog quantity example problem following your guidance last night, marking the key points in red pen. My understanding has deepened. Thank you!
Dinner is ready. Bring the two kids over to eat. There's their favorite pork rib soup today.
Honey, Hanhan keeps saying he wants you to come home and play blocks with him. Please come back early after work.
This afternoon I did emergency transformer repairs with Chen Jianguo on Jinmao Middle Road, and power was restored at 15:45.
For breakfast tomorrow, eat that rice noodle dish with lean pork.
I just saw on the forum that there is a lot of demand for smart lock repair. I'll talk to Wang Hai about it tonight.
Your savings card ending in 1234 spent RMB 358.00 at 16:50 on April 9. Merchant: Haikou Xinhua Bookstore (Jiefang Road Branch). Balance: 1234.56 yuan. [China Construction Bank]
Shift leader Zhang assigned the three of us to do the quarterly transformer maintenance at the food processing plant on Haisheng Road. Bring the megger.
Let's go to Sister's Spicy Soup Rice for lunch at noon; I've invited Zhao Qiang.
Hanhan has been dropped off at kindergarten, and Xuanxuan has arrived at school. Now I’m going to Dongcheng Tool Store to buy something.
Just got out of the hospital, and on the way I’ll buy two portions of lean pork rice rolls for Hanhan, and also stop at the convenience store in Banshan Garden to buy soy sauce and salt.
I'm so dizzy, can you come back?
Honey, when I ate with Jianguo, he said he wanted to go sea fishing, but I have to prepare the National Day family dinner, so I can't go.
Xuanxuan, hurry up and get up. There's a fire drill this afternoon—I'll be right back.
Got it
The kitchen is leaking. I'll go turn off the main valve first.
[Cainiao Station] Your package (Li ethnic group Hercules totem wine bottle) has arrived at the Jinmao East Road station. Please pick it up with your pickup code.
Qiang, I'm making stir-fried beef with bitter melon tonight. Bring some mangosteen back after work; Hanhan is craving them.
Okay, let's discuss the setting values and interlock issues of the star-delta starting in detail when we meet.
Wife: I checked the canvas bag; everything is there.
Today I went out in blue work clothes. Tomorrow I'll leave at 9 a.m. to go to my parents' house.
Great-uncle will arrive tomorrow afternoon. Is the guest room ready?
I'm going to the flower shop to pick something up. I'll be back later.
Today I'm going to work in the Bazao area on Yanzao Road; be safe.
This morning I finished replacing all three electricity meters. I'll continue tomorrow.
Lijuan, Mom has finished pickling the sour cabbage. Remember to bring it tomorrow. Also, I've noted the money your brother transferred; we'll handle it as discussed.
The soy milk is hanging on the handlebars. Come downstairs and get it.
Insulated cable ties and a screwdriver are already in the backpack, ready to go.
Honey, I bought some Hainan rice noodles for breakfast.
Squad Leader Zhang arranged for us to go to Yongwan Road; get your tools ready.
Went to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice Fast Food Restaurant and had spicy soup rice; it was much warmer.
Bin Ge, want to go to New World Department Store this afternoon to buy shoes? What time is convenient for you?
No problem, see you at three.
I cooked Hainan noodles and heated up buns for breakfast, and brewed you some laoba tea. Get up and eat.
Breakfast is ready — hurry up and eat. I've packed herbal tea and sunscreen in the canvas bag; don't forget when you're fixing the roof.

Mingqiang, just now I heard Xuanxuan and Hanhan in the back seat talking about Grandpa's electrician stories. Xuanxuan said it was cool, and Hanhan said Grandpa was amazing — the kids really admire him! Did you hear them up front?

Today I went to a Hatha yoga class. At first the movements felt so awkward that I almost lost my balance, but when I did the spinal twist pose, my spine popped and it felt so good. Hey, it really works!
Mom made Wenchang chicken, winged beans, winter melon and white clam soup, and steamed mackerel. Come and eat!
Brother Lu, thanks to your guidance on troubleshooting the circuit last night, the power was restored quickly. Thank you so much!

Tonight I taught Zixuan the area of rectangles. He kept thinking about cartoons. I reminded him three times and finally spoke harshly, but it didn't work well. I need to try a different approach tomorrow.
Zixuan had a breakthrough in math tonight. As soon as I explained it with the area teaching aids, he understood, and he got several problems right on his own. I praised him a lot.

Just now I was tutoring Xuanxuan. He complained about my teaching, and I almost lost my temper. Then I remembered what the safety-training psychology teacher said about understanding children's emotions. I took three deep breaths, changed my approach, and let him explain the problems. It worked much better than yesterday.
Dad, I got all the questions right on today's math test! Next week I want you to teach me again!
Mahjong at the usual place at 3 p.m., don't be late.
At today's meeting they said you lost money playing mahjong. Don't let it bother you! Are you still going to play later?
A Feng, I can't make the squash training tonight. Something came up. I'm really sorry! Let's schedule another time, and I'll treat.
At noon today I went to Jiajie Spicy Soup Rice with a colleague. I deliberately took less rice and more greens, skipped the Coke and only drank plain water—starting to eat healthy now.
Mingqiang, when you said you'd quit smoking at noon today, I truly support you! For the sake of the kids, we men keep our word. Whenever a craving hits in the future, come to me, I'll chat with you.

Honey, my physical exam results came out today. I weigh 72 kg, BMI 24.8. The doctor said I'm borderline overweight and recommended controlling my diet and increasing aerobic exercise. Let's cook with less oil and salt at home from now on—I need to take care of my health.
Brother Lin, my backhand practice went really well today, all thanks to you as my practice partner. I've also arranged to study together with my son, which puts my mind at ease. Thanks!
Today the line renovation was completed and went quite smoothly. Manager Li even specially thanked Squad Leader Zhang.
The network has finally come back to life!
I've booked tomorrow's dinner. Don't stand me up!
Tomorrow evening at 6:30, the usual place. The private room has been booked. Be sure to come.

Zhao Qiang, I saw two electrician job postings in Yongzhou in the hometown group chat that seem suitable for you: ① Yongzhou Hongfa Electrician Co., Ltd., monthly salary 6,000-8,000 yuan, with five social insurances and one housing fund, located in Lengshuitan; ② Yongzhou Jincheng Electromechanical Engineering Company, monthly salary 5,500-7,500 yuan, free meals and accommodation, in Lingling District. Both seem pretty reliable. Think it over, and go for it!
I've got the family covered. Don't worry about your exam prep—I'll handle the kids and the housework.
Listening to Dad talk about the emergency repairs back then, I felt a responsibility to pass on this craft, and I must pass this exam this time.
Today I had tea with my master. He said my skills are fine, I just haven't read enough books, and I'm sure to pass the senior technician exam. Hearing that made me feel much more at ease.
Zixuan, after you finish your test next weekend, Dad will take you to the toy store at Yixin City to buy the electronic building blocks you have always wanted.
Just played with electronic building blocks with Xuanxuan and Hanhan, teaching them the principles of motors and gears. The little ones were thrilled.
Got the photo album back. The cover is clear, and I checked every page—no problems!
Lijuan, get ready. Let's head to Qiangxing Flea Market and see what good stuff we can find today.
Good work on the morning report. Your afternoon compensatory leave has been approved. Have a good rest.
